focused_concurrency_and_recovery_tests.detail: 7 passed, 1 existing Pydantic warning. Covers two OS processes claiming one ingest job, exactly one successful ingest and audit, simultaneous recovery of an expired ingest lease, competing upload-completion clients creating one job, expired ASR lease retry, and stale ASR lease fencing that prevents transcript publication.

limitations: All audio and database fixtures are synthetic. These tests establish application concurrency and recovery behavior, not clinical quality.
Competing TestClient instances exercise separate concurrent API clients; no real browser-tab workflow or production multi-host database was exercised.
The test command required local loopback socketpair access for TestClient; no external network calls were made.
